posts.text:
For the entirety of my politically-aware formative years, policy decisions were made mostly by an octogenarian senator from Kentucky

I am not from Kentucky, yet I will always remember seeing him on the senate floor claim that making voting day a holiday would be “socialism”

"What works on the coast doesn't work in the middle of the country (for some unexplained reason, despite that being an inane statement) so we should instead force the highly populated coastal states to be subjected to policies voted for by a minority of voters in less populated places to be fair"
He also did some of the original advertising posters for Disney World. To my knowledge, someone somewhere in my family has the originals but not him.

Fun fact: my grandfather designed the original Burger King “bun” logo 

Like, for realsies. He got like $200 for it I think.

Well that uploaded and processed much faster than expected!

Here is a new episode of my Satisfactory let's play, in which I go on a grand adventure and put my hubris on full display

www.youtube.com/watch?v=ppVj...
If you wanna check it out, here's a playlist of the series so far: www.youtube.com/watch?v=S77e...

Uploading a Satisfactory lets play episode later today. My FUNDEAVORANCE channel on YouTube is almost to partner! Thank you to everyone who has been checking out this series. It’s such a blast to make, and I’m thrilled to see non-player-types enjoying it, too.

On to Phase 3 🏗️
Just one man’s opinion
I actually *don't* think we should go to war with Iran

WotC declined to voluntarily recognize our union by Friday, May 1st. While we're disappointed in this delay, together we remain strong in our convictions. We look forward to sitting down at the bargaining table so we can make Arena better for workers, for Wizards, and for our players.

#UWOTC-CWA

Stuff Keeps Happening, once again, has been snubbed for a Pulitzer

This is largely because it does not qualify for the award and also because if SKH got a Pulitzer, the world would be in serious trouble 

...more serious trouble.

My secret alter-ego will soon be revealed

So many cold cases will be solved when my true identity gets out to the public
Tbf I was the dumbass trying to install a window unit in a window that was essentially the minimum viable size for the unit

Weep for me, as I was lied to about the ease of installation of one New Window A/C Unit

It's done now but at what cost?

So what happens once we've finally finished perfectly automating sending emails back and forth forever using AI

What do we do as a species if our calling has been replaced?

It's wild to see clips of pundits on TV talking about how gutting the voting rights act has been a pet project of Roberts for decades and it's just like a little fun fact that he has a lifelong dedication to disenfranchising minorities from a position of near absolute power

Picked up a little something in LA 🥹

Afterlight won Best Ensemble Cast: Actual Play at the LA Webfest and I couldn’t be prouder.

Thank you to everyone who listened and loved our sad little show. For a story about spending the end with the people you love, this award feels pretty dang appropriate.

I regret to inform everyone that I, too, am shutting down my airline due to the Iran war

www.reuters.com/business/spi...

I believe I can identify the exact moment that TikTok started to truly die:

When they took away the ability to pin comments
